title: Armored Bard by the Pond
description: A female knight in ornate striped and scaled armor sits on a cracked stone ledge above dark water. She holds a wooden harp in her lap, with long blonde braids and a chainmail coif, surrounded by floating papers, lily pads and ghostly faces embedded in the broken stone below.
prompt: A solemn female knight wearing intricate black and white striped plate armor with green scale detailing sits on a crumbling stone ledge covered in moss. She holds a medieval wooden harp, has long blonde braids and a chainmail hood. Below her, the broken stone reveals multiple ghostly faces, while lily pads and scattered papers float in the dark water. Dramatic diagonal beams of purple and gold light cut through a dark arched background, in a detailed fantasy style with visible crack textures.
